full_list.title_en: Modeling of Rayleigh-type waves in a viscoelastic piezoelectric fiber-reinforced composite layered Structure
full_list.title_zh: 粘弹性压电纤维增强复合材料层状结构中瑞利型波的建模
full_list.abstract: The propagation of Rayleigh-type surface waves in a viscoelastic piezoelectric fiber-reinforced composite (VRFRC) layer bonded to an isotropic elastic half-space through a mechanically imperfect interface is investigated. Both constituents of the composite are dissipative: the PZT fibers are treated as viscoelastic piezoelectric solids and the epoxy matrix as a viscoelastic dielectric, each described by Kelvin–Voigt elements acting on the stress–strain and on the electric field–electric displacement pairs, so that every phase, and the homogenized composite, is passive. The complex , frequency-dependent effective constants are obtained by introducing the complex constituent constants into the strength-of-materials/rule-of-mixtures (SM/RM) relations through the elastic–viscoelastic correspondence principle. The imperfect bond is represented by normal and tangential linear-slip conditions, the upper surface is traction-free and electrically open, and the metallic substrate grounds the interface. An exact 8 × 8 complex dispersion relation is derived and solved, without any small-loss approximation, for the phase velocity and the normalized attenuation of the fundamental mode. The results show that the fiber volume fraction controls the dispersion through the layer stiffness and piezoelectric stiffening, the viscous relaxation times of the matrix (chiefly η c,q 33 and η c,q 44) control the attenuation while leaving the phase velocity almost unchanged, fiber viscoelasticity becomes significant only at high fiber content, and interfacial compliance, in particular the normal compliance, lowers the phase velocity and the attenuation in the dispersive range. Mode shapes, particle orbits, the electric potential distribution and a velocity-based electromechani-cal coupling measure are also analysed; the group velocity shows a pronounced Airy-phase minimum that is sensitive to the fiber content and the bond quality, and the velocity-based coupling measure K 2 = 2(c open − c short)/c open reaches about 3.3% for fiber-rich layers.
full_list.abstract_zh: 研究了粘弹性压电纤维增强复合材料（ VRFRC ）层中瑞利型表面波通过机械不完美界面结合到各向同性弹性半空间上的传播。复合材料的两种成分都是耗散的： PZT纤维被处理为粘弹性压电固体，环氧基体被处理为粘弹性电介质，各自由作用于应力应变和电场-电位移对的开尔文-沃伊特元素描述，因此每个相和均匀化复合材料都是被动的。复杂、频率相关的有效常数是通过弹性-粘弹性对应原理将复杂成分常数引入材料强度/混合规则（ SM/RM ）关系中获得的。

full_list.title_en: What a radical-pair quantum reservoir would require: readable capacity, no quantum advantage, and a nuclear-register criterion

full_list.abstract: Whether the electron--nuclear spin coherence behind radical-pair magnetoreception could also support biological emphcomputation has been conjectured for decades but never made quantitative. We treat a cryptochrome-type radical pair as a reservoir computer, solving the radical-pair master equation with electronic decoherence and driving it as a real turnover does---by the birth of a spin-correlated pair whose singlet character encodes the input. Three results follow, none of them the expected one. The reservoir is emphreadable by ordinary chemistry: the nuclear polarisation the product carries away gives an out-of-sample information-processing capacity of 4.7 against its own memoryless floor of 2.0, with no spectroscopy. There is no quantum advantage: a classical network matched channel-for-channel exceeds the five-spin reservoir by 49--123%. And the memory horizon is set not by the microsecond pair lifetime but by the turnover interval, because the nuclear register survives recombination in the diamagnetic product---so the binding constraint is chemical rather than temporal, namely that the emphsame register be reused between turnovers. Predicting the register's relaxation instead of assuming it makes that constraint testable: at the geomagnetic field a proton on the intact protein relaxes in milliseconds, not seconds, capping the horizon below the neural band unless the register's dipolar vector reorients about two and a half times faster than the protein (τᵣₘ ₑfflesssim6~ns). What survives is a smaller claim on firmer ground: a criterion whose two constants can be measured in vitro, in place of one whose central relaxation time was never measured at all.

full_list.title_zh: 受众对遗产文创产品的评价：评价者层面和产品层面方差的多层次分析
full_list.abstract: Studies of heritage-derived cultural-creative products often interpret audience ratings as differences between products, yet each rating also reflects the person who gives it. This study examined how these two sources of variance contribute to evaluations of six designs derived from the Wa jicong top, a spinning top from Yunnan, China. Each of 228 respondents rated two randomly assigned designs, giving 456 evaluations. Crossed random-effects models estimated the rater and product shares of each response, and within-rater and between-rater analyses separated two kinds of association among evaluative judgements. Raters accounted for 81.6% of the variance in design perception, 81.8% in perceived cultural authenticity and 56.1% in aesthetic evaluation. Average differences between products accounted for less than 1% of each judgement; these shares were similar under alternative sample screenings. Cultural familiarity, measured through self-rated knowledge of the source culture and interest in ethnic styling, explained 7.2% to 22.8% of rater-level variance. The ranking of products on authenticity also varied with familiarity. Of the descriptive perceptions, dynamism showed the clearest product difference (product share 4.9%), although its observed ordering did not follow the designs' intended static and dynamic forms. The three evaluative judgements were strongly associated between raters. Within raters, no association between authenticity and aesthetic evaluation was detected, including after correction for measurement error. The indirect association of design perception with aesthetic evaluation through authenticity was 0.31 between raters and 0.00 within them. In this design system, evaluative scores primarily distinguished audience members. Repeated-stimulus studies should report how variance divides between raters and products and distinguish within-rater from between-rater associations before interpreting pooled coefficients.

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《受众对遗产文创产品的评价：评价者层面和产品层面方差的多层次分析》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: The general Stokes’ theorem as the mechanism for synchronizing 2s2p electrons within a neon atom
full_list.title_zh: 作为氖原子内 2s2p 电子同步机制的斯托克斯一般定理
full_list.abstract: Points, arcs, surfaces, and solids are four orthogonal space dimensions of a sphere. When they are applied to the description of the atomic structure of a neon shell, we draw the conclusion that both full-fledged 2px electronic orbitals manifest as two diametric points; both 2py orbitals take the shape of two semicircular arcs; both 2pz orbitals spread over two hemispherical surfaces; and both 2s orbitals form a solid spherical layer. The electrons transform from one type of orbitals to another cyclically following dynamic calculus of spherical quantities rather than linear algebra of physical quantities. Such dimensional transformations entail a fresh approach to solving harmonic oscillation equations and lead to the discovery of the synchronization mechanism for 2s2p electrons by Green’s theorem, Stokes’ theorem, and Gauss’s theorem. We make fine geometrical distinctions between 2px, 2py, and 2pz electronic orbitals, which are backwards compatible with those in quantum mechanics. Electronic orbitals are characterized from geometry, trigonometry, dynamic calculus, and vector integral calculus in a coherent manner. Their elegant coordination mechanism is a great benefit of 2p orbitals anisotropy in the four-dimensional space gradients, furnishing strong evidence of the quaternity theory for a neon atom, and providing a sharp insight into the mechanisms that regulate the biosphere on the earth and the immune system of a human body.
full_list.abstract_zh: 点、弧、面和实体是球体的四个正交空间维度。当它们应用于氖壳原子结构的描述时，我们得出的结论是，两个成熟的 2px 电子轨道都表现为两个直径点；两个 2py 轨道均呈两个半圆弧形状；两个 2pz 轨道分布在两个半球形表面上；两个 2s 轨道形成实心球层。电子遵循球面量的动态演算而不是物理量的线性代数，循环地从一种类型的轨道转变为另一种类型的轨道。这种维度变换需要一种解决简谐振动方程的新方法，并通过格林定理、斯托克斯定理和高斯定理发现了 2s2p 电子的同步机制。

full_list.abstract: Hypericum species are potential sources of essential oils. Whereas there exists reported work on volatile constituents of Hypericum essential oils (Eos) from other parts of the world, the species of Hypericums in Kenya remain largely unexplored. The current study assessed the chemical variability of Eos from five Hypericum species collected in Kenya using multivariate chemometric approaches. Eos were extracted by hydrodistillation and analyzed using gas chromatography–mass spectrometry (GC–MS). Further, prediction of activity spectra for substances was done. After data cleaning, including merging duplicate compounds, removing absent compounds, and autoscaling, a dataset of 113 compounds was subjected to principal component analysis (PCA), Pearson correlation analysis, hierarchical cluster analysis, phytochemical class profiling, diversity indices, Venn analysis, and discriminating-compound assessment. The volatile profiles showed clear interspecific variation. Sesquiterpenes predominated in Hypericum kiboense, Hypericum roeperianum, Hypericum peplidifolium, and Hypericum scioanum, whereas Hypericum revolutum contained a stronger monoterpene component dominated by α-pinene (43.04%) and caryophyllene (19.40%). The first two principal components explained 68.2% of total variation and clearly separated the species. Correlation analysis revealed generally weak similarities among species, except for the strong relationship between H. peplidifolium and H. scioanum (r = 0.81). Cluster analysis identified three major chemotypic groups. Diversity metrics further highlighted substantial differences in richness, evenness, and overall diversity among species. The five Hypericum species possess distinct but partially overlapping volatile oil fingerprints and are not chemically interchangeable. The results provide a valuable foundation for chemotaxonomy, quality control, and future bioactivity-guided investigations. The predicted biological activity profile showed that antieczematic activity had the highest number of occurrences across the investigated Hypericum essential oils, followed by antineoplastic and apoptosis agonist activities. The ranking table further showed that some less frequent activities, such as spasmolytic urinary activity and mucomembranous protection, had high weighted mean Pa scores, suggesting strong but more narrowly distributed predicted bioactivity.

full_list.title_en: Synergistic Fire Protection and Water Resistance of Intumescent Coatings via Surface- Engineered Shell-Derived Biogenic Inorganic Particles
full_list.title_zh: 通过表面工程贝壳衍生的生物无机颗粒实现膨胀型涂料的协同防火和耐水性
full_list.abstract: Steel-structure intumescent fire-retardant coatings suffer from poor water resistance and weak high-temperature char layers. Herein, shell-derived biogenic inorganic particles (SBIPs) were surface-functionalized with KH-550 and incorporated as a bio-based synergistic filler into silicone-acrylic/epoxy waterborne intumescent coatings (IFR-EP/SAE). Characterizations including combustion simulation, thermogravimetry, limiting oxygen index (LOI), cone calorimetry, SEM, and Raman spectroscopy were performed to investigate interfacial compatibility, fire protection, thermal stability, water-aging resistance, and char evolution. KH-550 functionalization improved SBIP–matrix compatibility, while a distinct biphasic concentration-dependent effect on flame retardancy was observed, with 3 wt.% SE-SBIPs showing optimal performance. Compared with the blank control, the addition amount of 3 wt. % reduced the peak back-side steel temperature to 289.27°C, increased the LOI to 42.5%, and raised the initial rapid thermal-degradation temperature from 304 to 363°C. After 48 h water immersion, it maintained favorable flame-retardant and smoke-suppression performance, with reduced peak heat-release rate and total smoke release. Raman analysis showed a decreased ID/IG ratio from 1.36 to 1.07, indicating enhanced char graphitization. This work provides a sustainable strategy for developing durable bio-based fire-protective coatings.

full_list.title_en: A study of particle behaviour in dynamic extracellular environments using nanoparticles as model nanoscale probes
full_list.title_zh: 使用纳米粒子作为模型纳米级探针研究动态细胞外环境中的粒子行为
full_list.abstract: Quantifying nanoparticle behaviour in complex biological environments is essential for understanding transport and interactions within heterogeneous living systems. Fluorescent labelling is commonly used to visualise nanoparticles; however, surface modification by fluorescent probes can alter nanoparticle interactions and obscure native behaviour. Therefore, accessible label-free methods are needed to characterise nanoparticle dynamics under biologically relevant conditions. In this study, an optical caustics-based microscopy technique was used to track the motion of 100 nm gold nanoparticles in the extracellular space above human mesenchymal stem cell (hMSC) monolayers. Nanoparticle trajectories were analysed using diffusion coefficients, anomalous diffusion exponents, and convex hull metrics to quantify transport behaviour. Results demonstrated that the local extracellular environment significantly influences nanoparticle dynamics. In the presence of fetal bovine serum, nanoparticle diffusion rates changed significantly after one hour of exposure to the hMSC layer. Surface charge, protein content, and particle localisation relative to cells also had a marked effect on mobility. Comparison with idealised Brownian transport predictions showed that the living extracellular environment behaves as a dynamic and evolving transport medium that modifies nanoparticle movement. These findings highlight the sensitivity of nanoscale transport to local biological conditions and establish a label-free framework for investigating nanoparticle dynamics in heterogeneous biological systems.
full_list.abstract_zh: 量化复杂生物环境中纳米粒子的行为对于理解异质生命系统内的运输和相互作用至关重要。荧光标记通常用于可视化纳米颗粒；然而，荧光探针的表面修饰可以改变纳米粒子的相互作用并掩盖天然行为。因此，需要可用的无标记方法来表征生物学相关条件下的纳米颗粒动力学。在这项研究中，使用基于光学焦散的显微镜技术来跟踪 100 nm 金纳米颗粒在人间充质干细胞 (hMSC) 单层上方细胞外空间中的运动。使用扩散系数、异常扩散指数和凸包度量来分析纳米颗粒轨迹，以量化传输行为。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 量化复杂生物环境中纳米粒子的行为对于理解异质生命系统内的运输和相互作用至关重要。荧光标记通常用于可视化纳米颗粒；然而，荧光探针的表面修饰可以改变纳米粒子的相互作用并掩盖天然行为。因此，需要可用的无标记方法来表征生物学相关条件下的纳米颗粒动力学。在这项研究中，使用基于光学焦散的显微镜技术来跟踪 100 nm 金纳米颗粒在人间充质干细胞 (hMSC) 单层上方细胞外空间中的运动。使用扩散系数、异常扩散指数和凸包度量来分析纳米颗粒轨迹，以量化传输行为。结果表明，局部细胞外环境显着影响纳米颗粒动力学。在存在胎牛血清的情况下，纳米粒子扩散速率在暴露于 hMSC 层一小时后显着变化。表面电荷、蛋白质含量和相对于细胞的颗粒定位也对迁移率有显着影响。与理想化布朗运输预测的比较表明，活的细胞外环境表现为动态且不断变化的运输介质，可以改变纳米颗粒的运动。这些发现强调了纳米级运输对局部生物条件的敏感性，并建立了用于研究异质生物系统中纳米颗粒动力学的无标记框架。

full_list.title_en: Comparative performance analysis of direct-coupled DC and variable-frequency AC photovoltaic water pumping systems under tropical climatic conditions
full_list.title_zh: 热带气候条件下直耦直流和变频交流光伏抽水系统性能比较分析
full_list.abstract: Rural tropical areas often lack grid access and increasingly rely on photovoltaic water pumping. This study numerically compares two architectures under identical conditions (PV array, motor pump, hydraulic system, and demand): a direct-coupled DC system and a variable-frequency AC system with MPPT. Simulations use Typical Meteorological Year data (2005–2023) from four Cameroon sites, Meskine, Agola, Mbé, and Soa, at a 1-min time step. full_list.title_en: Development and Experimental Validation of a Dual-Input Dual-Output DC-DC Converter for PV–Battery Hybrid Energy Systems
full_list.title_zh: 用于光伏电池混合能源系统的双输入双输出DC-DC转换器的开发和实验验证
full_list.abstract: Due to the inherently fluctuating nature of renewable energy sources, their output current and voltage exhibit significant intermittency, rendering them insufficient for standalone sustainable power delivery. To address this, hybrid systems combining renewables with auxiliary storage or generation units are commonly deployed. This study introduces an innovative dual-input dual-output (DIDO) DC-DC converter configuration utilizing a T-source impedance network. In the proposed setup, a photovoltaic (PV) array and a battery storage unit serve as the dual input ports. The converter is controlled such that the battery compensates for any power deficits when the PV output falls short of the load requirements, whereas excess PV generation is directed to charge the battery during surplus periods. The mathematical model and operational modes of the converter are thoroughly analyzed. Additionally, the Hill Climbing algorithm is implemented to realize Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) for the PV system. The feasibility of the design is assessed through MATLAB/Simulink simulations and verified experimentally using a hardware prototype under diverse operating scenarios.

full_list.title_en: Low-Pressure Investment Casting of Ductile Iron: Effect of Controlled Filling on Graphite Morphology and Fracture Mechanisms

full_list.abstract: This study investigates the effect of low-pressure investment casting (LPIC), a novel process, on the integrity and mechanical properties of ductile iron castings in comparison with conventional gravity investment casting (GIC). Although investment casting is widely used for high-precision components, its application to ductile iron remains limited by turbulence-induced defects and insufficient control of solidification conditions. To eliminate compositional variability, EN-GJS-500 ductile iron castings were produced by both processes from a single melt and evaluated by tensile, Charpy impact and hardness testing, light microscopy and scanning electron microscopy (SEM) of the fracture surfaces. Compared with GIC, LPIC increased the ultimate tensile strength by approximately 22% (from 564 to 687 MPa) and the elongation by approximately 52%, whereas the yield strength and hardness remained comparable. The impact strength decreased by approximately 29%, although with considerably lower scatter. The LPIC castings exhibited a higher nodule count, a smaller mean nodule diameter (28 µm vs. 51 µm) and a more homogeneous graphite distribution. Fractography revealed a transition in the dominant fracture mechanism from graphite nodule fracture in GIC to matrix-controlled failure in LPIC. These findings suggest that the benefits of LPIC extend beyond a reduced defect population and include a modification of the graphite–matrix interaction and load transfer. The combination of laminar filling and pressure-assisted solidification is considered to reduce bifilm formation and enhance feeding. LPIC therefore represents a promising route for improving the performance of ductile iron investment castings in demanding engineering applications.

full_list.title_en: Reconstructed Reality: Enabling Teleportation-Based Locomotion in Immersive Telepresence

full_list.abstract: High latency and virtual reality (VR) sickness hinders the mass adoption of telepresence or teleoperated systems utilizing head-mounted displays (HMDs). In immersive telepresence scenarios that use 360 degree cameras to present the remote environment, latencies of up to seconds are expected. Such delays make traditional continuous manual control of these systems difficult. In addition, due to the use of HMDs, users of these systems are prone to VR sickness. We present a novel method to enable an improved telepresence locomotion experience under these constraints. The paper first recounts a previously published article of a prototype design, and then integrates new findings of a realistic use-case, replicating and extending these findings. We conclude that it is highly beneficial to use teleportation through a real-time 3D reconstructed virtual environment as an interface to a physical environment (VEIPE) in embodied immersive telepresence, relative to a standard joystick-based continuous control method.

full_list.title_en: Machine Learning and GIS-Integrated Framework for Irrigation Water Quality Index (IWQI) Mapping and Hydrochemical Clustering in an Algerian Semi-Arid Watershed

full_list.abstract: In the Ain Temouchent region, surface water is severely limited, leaving groundwater as the primary source for both domestic supply and agricultural irrigation. This study evaluates the suitability of El Melah watershed groundwater for irrigation by computing the Irrigation Water Quality Index (IWQI) following the Meireles approach, mapping its spatial distribution through GIS, and complementing the analysis with two machine learning methods: (i) a Random Forest (RF) model with Leave-One-Out Cross-Validation (LOOCV) and SHAP explainability analysis to identify the dominant drivers of IWQI degradation; and (ii) K-means and hierarchical clustering to delineate hydrochemical facies and provide a statistically grounded alternative to the conventional Wilcox diagram. Salinity is elevated throughout the study area (EC: 1,034–5,010 µS cm⁻¹). The RF model achieved LOOCV R² = 0.61, with Na⁺ and EC confirmed as the dominant IWQI degradation drivers by SHAP analysis. Hierarchical clustering resolved three hydrochemical facies: a Ca²⁺-HCO₃⁻ continental group, a Na⁺-Cl⁻ evaporite-influenced group, and a seawater-intrusion group, all confirmed as statistically distinct by one-way ANOVA (p < 0.05). Overall, groundwater quality in the watershed ranges from moderate to severe restriction for irrigation use, with the northern sector most critically affected by marine infiltration.

full_list.title_en: Eichhornia crassipes management in a eutrophic reservoir: Cover reduction, rapid recolonization, and cyanobacterial dynamics
full_list.title_zh: 富营养化水库中的Eichhornia crassipes管理：覆盖减少，快速再定植和蓝藻动力学
full_list.abstract: Mechanical harvesting is widely used to control Eichhornia crassipes in reservoirs, yet its performance is judged by biomass removed rather than the reduction and stabilization of plant cover. We integrated a 129 month Sentinel-1 time series derived using U-Net segmentation with harvesting records and water quality monitoring to evaluate harvest campaigns, recurrent expansion and phytoplankton responses in a 177 ha eutrophic tropical urban reservoir. Harvesting effort was not proportional to cover change: campaigns with comparable biomass removal produced contrasting outcomes. Cover reductions were followed by recolonization, with the two fastest episodes doubling reservoir scale cover in 19 and 20 days. Expansion was fastest after low cover phases and declined as open water surface became occupied, whereas harvesting imposed a weaker constraint on cover gain. At the reservoir outlet, higher cover was associated with lower cyanobacterial density and dominance during the dry season, while chlorophyll-a remained unrelated to cover. Station specific Random Forest models interpreted with explainable AI (SHAP) retained true color and macrophyte cover as main predictors of cyanobacterial density. These findings distinguish three dimensions often conflated in macrophyte management: operational effort, spatial outcome and ecological state. Harvested biomass should therefore be treated as an effort metric, whereas net cover change, residual cover and rebound provide direct measures of management performance. Combining deep learning satellite mapping, operational records, explainable machine learning and in situ monitoring can support adaptive harvesting, but durable control will also require reductions in nutrient and suspended solid loads.
full_list.abstract_zh: 机械收获被广泛用于控制水库中的Eichhornia crassipes ，但其性能是通过去除生物量而不是减少和稳定植被来判断的。我们将使用U-Net分割得出的129个月Sentinel-1时间序列与收获记录和水质监测相结合，以评估177公顷富营养热带城市水库的收获活动、反复扩张和浮游植物反应。收获努力与覆盖变化不成比例：具有可比生物质去除的活动产生了对比的结果。覆盖率降低后进行了重新定植，最快的两次发作分别在19天和20天内使水库规模覆盖率翻了一番。

core_items.title_en: Modeling of Rayleigh-type waves in a viscoelastic piezoelectric fiber-reinforced composite layered Structure
core_items.title_zh: 粘弹性压电纤维增强复合材料层状结构中瑞利型波的建模
core_items.abstract: The propagation of Rayleigh-type surface waves in a viscoelastic piezoelectric fiber-reinforced composite (VRFRC) layer bonded to an isotropic elastic half-space through a mechanically imperfect interface is investigated. Both constituents of the composite are dissipative: the PZT fibers are treated as viscoelastic piezoelectric solids and the epoxy matrix as a viscoelastic dielectric, each described by Kelvin–Voigt elements acting on the stress–strain and on the electric field–electric displacement pairs, so that every phase, and the homogenized composite, is passive. The complex , frequency-dependent effective constants are obtained by introducing the complex constituent constants into the strength-of-materials/rule-of-mixtures (SM/RM) relations through the elastic–viscoelastic correspondence principle. The imperfect bond is represented by normal and tangential linear-slip conditions, the upper surface is traction-free and electrically open, and the metallic substrate grounds the interface. An exact 8 × 8 complex dispersion relation is derived and solved, without any small-loss approximation, for the phase velocity and the normalized attenuation of the fundamental mode. The results show that the fiber volume fraction controls the dispersion through the layer stiffness and piezoelectric stiffening, the viscous relaxation times of the matrix (chiefly η c,q 33 and η c,q 44) control the attenuation while leaving the phase velocity almost unchanged, fiber viscoelasticity becomes significant only at high fiber content, and interfacial compliance, in particular the normal compliance, lowers the phase velocity and the attenuation in the dispersive range. Mode shapes, particle orbits, the electric potential distribution and a velocity-based electromechani-cal coupling measure are also analysed; the group velocity shows a pronounced Airy-phase minimum that is sensitive to the fiber content and the bond quality, and the velocity-based coupling measure K 2 = 2(c open − c short)/c open reaches about 3.3% for fiber-rich layers.
core_items.abstract_zh: 研究了粘弹性压电纤维增强复合材料（ VRFRC ）层中瑞利型表面波通过机械不完美界面结合到各向同性弹性半空间上的传播。复合材料的两种成分都是耗散的： PZT纤维被处理为粘弹性压电固体，环氧基体被处理为粘弹性电介质，各自由作用于应力应变和电场-电位移对的开尔文-沃伊特元素描述，因此每个相和均匀化复合材料都是被动的。复杂、频率相关的有效常数是通过弹性-粘弹性对应原理将复杂成分常数引入材料强度/混合规则（ SM/RM ）关系中获得的。
